topic.title: Crossing Comment Ranges
topic.shortdesc: The two reviewers comment on ranges that overlap partially, so neither range contains the other.

section.title: Overview
section.p: Tokens are signed with the key configured in the properties file before the service starts.
Set the property auth.signing.key in the configuration file.

ol.li: Stop the running service instance and drain the connections.
Edit the properties file and set the signing key.

section.p: The service writes an audit record for every login attempt that it rejects.
